name: tronlink-skills
description: AI Agent skills for TronLink wallet — wallet management, token queries, DEX swap, energy/bandwidth resource management, and TRX staking on the TRON network.

scripts.postinstall:
npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix frontend && echo '
  ✅ tronlink-skills installed!
  Skills: tron-wallet, tron-token, tron-market, tron-swap, tron-resource, tron-staking
  Run: npx tron-api --help
'
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix frontend
